scope: Actual read-only editor-world Visibility queries. Vertical rays sample ground response. Horizontal capsules approximate a human-size clearance envelope on selected tracks. These results are not character movement, NavMesh, AI reachability, vehicle clearance, complete 4 m band coverage, or target-platform performance certification.

complex_seam_diagnostics.scope: Additional complex Visibility ray diagnostics for original failed ground samples only. Repeat the exact original point, then offset perpendicular to its nearest 500 cm ground-tile seam by -1, -0.1, +0.1 and +1 cm. These results never replace original samples or change original query counts. A nearby hit does not turn the original miss into a pass.
complex_seam_diagnostics.interpretation: The exact seam misses repeat, while every sampled offset of 0.1 cm or 1 cm hits the neighbouring expected ground tile. This supports sensitivity of exact complex rays at tile boundaries; it does not prove the precise cause or eliminate sub-millimetre collision discontinuity. The original 11 misses remain failures in the original counts. No extended no-hit area was observed at the sampled offsets.

resolved_entrance_obstruction.original_geometric_review_limit: The earlier bounds check protected the entrance tile itself, but its 10 m traversal continues into the lot and reached the fence at X about 8307 cm. The actual sweep caught this deeper approach obstruction.

collision_asset_inspection.scope: Actual collision settings on the ground tiles, main building bodies and vehicles referenced by this layout. GetSimpleCollisionCount counts Box/Sphere/Sphyl only; convex primitives are queried separately.
collision_asset_inspection.world_component_count_scope: All StaticMeshComponents in the queried editor world, including environment components; this is not the count of authored rows in Layout.json.

limitations: Collision query settings are channel-specific. Visibility results do not automatically transfer to every future gameplay collision channel.
Three parallel capsule tracks are sampled through each corridor; untested lateral positions, stepping, jumping, sloped motion and complete player reachability remain unverified.
